notes: Bounds are broad engineering assumptions, not official ratings or confidence intervals.
capacity_ah and ocv_offset_v are shared nuisance parameters; compare nuisance-only versus joint calibration.
CI is a local linearized block-wild approximation, not an exact finite-sample guarantee; bounds and identifiability limitations must be shown.
V2 adds a 5% relative net-energy residual because V1 training MAPE worsened from 16.39% to 22.60%; no V2 settings are selected using trip600 outcomes.
Trip600 was already evaluated for V1. V2 trip600 results are retrospective diagnostics, not independent confirmatory testing.
No per-trip nuisance parameters or test-specific capacity adjustments are permitted.
